name: Ocal Browser v9.5.07 (Stable)
body:
## 🌌 Ocal Browser v9.5.07 (Stable) — Release Notes

### 📦 Overhauled Custom Inno Setup Installer
* **Windows 11 DWM Architecture**: Custom native caption and rounded frame integration (`DWMWCP_ROUND`) with seamless titlebar.
* **Modern Slate Design System**: Clean typography and deep slate color hierarchy (`#0F172A`), subtle borders, surface cards, and refined indigo accents.
* **Streamlined Hero & Installation Flow**: Redesigned hero branding card with live version badge, full-width primary CTA button, inline Terms of Service & Privacy link, and expandable options panel (2-column layout for desktop shortcut, start menu, auto-launch, protocol handling).
* **Segmented Legal & Privacy Modal**: 3-tab segmented viewer (Key Highlights, Privacy & Sync, Full Legal EULA).
* **Modern Uninstaller Interface**: Clean 540x260 confirmation dialog with embedded feedback card and modern progress window.

### 🗂️ Vertical Tab Cards & UI Polish
* Refined vertical tab layouts with subtle card borders, rounded corners, and crisp favicon alignment.
* Polished tab group design and smoother hover/active states based on user feedback.
* Harmonized color tokens and spacing throughout the browser chrome.

### ⚡ Core Engine & Dependency Updates
* **Electron Engine**: Updated to `v43.7.2`.
* **Updated Dependencies**: Modernized core libraries including `three@0.186.1`, `adm-zip@0.6.1`, `border-beam@1.4.1`, `liquid-gooey@0.2.2`, `thinking-orbs@0.3.2`, and `voice-glow@0.2.1`.

### 🔐 Authenticode Code Signing & Microsoft Compatibility
* Signed with SHA-256 Authenticode digital signature.
* Verified with DigiCert RFC 3161 TimeStamping responder for Microsoft Partner Center and Windows release validation.
